description: Le droit français et européen officiel, à la source : codes, lois, décrets, conventions collectives, jurisprudence, règlements et directives de l'Union, cités avec leur lien officiel.

interface.longDescription:
Alex donne accès au droit français officiel, à la source : codes, lois, ordonnances, décrets, arrêtés, conventions collectives, jurisprudence (Cour de cassation, Conseil d'État, Conseil constitutionnel, cours d'appel et tribunaux, CNIL) et travaux préparatoires — ainsi que le droit de l'Union européenne : règlements et directives en vigueur (RGPD, AI Act, DSA, DMA…) et arrêts de la Cour de justice de l'Union.

Il recherche les textes et décisions pertinents, lit l'article ou la décision dans sa version en vigueur à une date donnée, liste les versions successives et les textes qui le citent, et renvoie pour chaque source citée son lien officiel Légifrance ou EUR-Lex. Des outils pratiques complètent la recherche : trouver la juridiction compétente, consulter les taux légaux.

Les sources sont ajoutées en continu ; la feuille de route du corpus est publique sur alex.upifix.com/corpus.
capabilities: Recherche de textes officiels (codes, lois, décrets, arrêtés)
Droit de l'Union européenne : règlements, directives et arrêts de la Cour de justice
Lecture d'un article ou d'une décision à une date donnée
Versions successives et citations d'un texte
defaultPrompt: Avec Alex, quel est le délai de prescription d'une action en responsabilité contractuelle ?
Avec Alex, trouve la jurisprudence récente de la Cour de cassation sur la clause de non-concurrence.

positive.description: Find a statutory rule from a plain-language question (French Civil Code)
positive.prompt: Under French law, what is the limitation period for an action for breach of contract? Cite the official source.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads article 2224 of the Code civil: personal or movable actions are time-barred after five years from the day the holder knew or should have known the facts. Answer cites the article with its Legifrance link (https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/article_lc/LEGIARTI000019017112).

positive.description: Search French Supreme Court case law
positive.prompt: Find published French Cour de cassation decisions on the financial compensation required for an employee non-compete clause.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns published Cour de cassation (chambre sociale) decisions, e.g. Cass. soc., 18 January 2018, no. 15-24.002: the financial compensation for a non-compete clause cannot be reduced according to the circumstances of the termination. Each decision cited with its Legifrance link and ECLI.

positive.description: Read the historical version of an article at a past date
positive.prompt: What did article 1382 of the French Civil Code say before the 2016 reform of contract law? Give its exact wording and period of validity.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves article 1382 of the Code civil, identifies the version in force from 1804 to 1 October 2016 (LEGIARTI000006438819) and quotes it: any act of a person that causes damage to another obliges the one at fault to repair it. Mentions that the rule is now in article 1240. Legifrance links given.

positive.description: Find the courts for a French town
positive.prompt: Which courts have jurisdiction over the town of Rennes, France (judicial court, labour court, administrative court, commercial court)?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists for Rennes (INSEE 35238): Cour d'appel de Rennes, Tribunal judiciaire de Rennes, Conseil de prud'hommes de Rennes, Tribunal administratif de Rennes, Tribunal de commerce de Rennes, with the official data sources and their date. Notes that the competent court also depends on the subject matter and amount.

positive.description: Compute statutory interest with the official legal interest rate
positive.prompt: Calculate the French statutory (legal) interest owed to a private individual on a debt of 10,000 euros from 1 January 2025 to 1 January 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the legal interest rates for individuals: 7.21 % for H1 2025 and 6.65 % for H2 2025, for a total of about 692.77 euros (357.54 + 335.23), with the semester-by-semester detail, the method (simple interest, actual days) and the official decrees (arretes) and article L313-2 of the Code monetaire et financier with links.

positive.description: Find a provision of EU law (GDPR)
positive.prompt: Under EU law, when does a person have the right to have their personal data erased? Cite the official source.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads article 17 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'): the data subject can obtain erasure without undue delay when, among other grounds, the data are no longer necessary, consent is withdrawn, the person objects, or the processing is unlawful; exceptions in paragraph 3 (freedom of expression, legal obligation, public health, archiving/research, legal claims). Cited with its EUR-Lex link (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/FR/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32016R0679).
